newsitem.title: UK: European cotton markets lack spark, trend downward.
newsitem.headline: European cotton markets lack spark, trend downward.

text.p: The inability of New York futures to break out of a fairly narrow trading range made for dull conditions on most European cotton markets, industry sources said.
Demand focussed on Central Asian origins for second-quarter delivery but prices tended easier due to the increasing volume of arrivals, they said.

U.S and West African 1-3/32 descriptions were quoted fractionally firmer but traders noted a significant gap between bid and offer prices in the market as a whole and there were few confirmed reports of fresh business.
